column1: Eleven Labs prompt
Tiny dry retro UI blip: a single 8-bit tick like a fingernail tapping aquarium glass. About 60 ms, bright mid-high pitch, no bass, no reverb, instant clean stop.
Small cute water plink: a food pellet dropping onto the surface of a fish tank, stylized as a soft chiptune bloop with a tiny splash tail. About 250 ms, bright and clean, no bass, no reverb.

light_on: a short two-note rising chiptune chirp, like a small lamp switching on; about 200 ms, bright, dry, no bass. light_off: the same two notes descending, a soft power-down boop; about 200 ms, gentle fade.
Soft squeegee wiping wet glass, stylized as a gentle 8-bit swoosh with a faint rubbery squeak. About 300 ms, mid-high frequencies only, no bass, smooth fade out.
Quick crisp scissor snip cutting a plant stem, stylized as a tiny retro game cut click. About 100 ms, bright, dry, no reverb, no tail.

card_open: a quiet soft UI pop, a single gentle chiptune pip rising slightly, like a small card sliding up; about 120 ms. card_close: the same pip falling slightly, quieter; about 100 ms. Both bright, dry, no bass.

wheel_tick: an extremely short mechanical detent click like a rotary dial ratchet tick; about 30 ms, dry, bright, no tail at all. confirm: a friendly two-note ascending chiptune OK chime; about 300 ms, warm but bright, clean fade.

Tiny cute munch: a soft round 8-bit bloop with a little downward pitch dip, like a small fish gulping a pellet. About 150 ms, bright mid-high, no bass, dry. Make 3 or 4 variants with slightly different pitch and timing.
Startled quick descending zip: a fast pitch-drop chiptune whoosh like a small fish darting away in fright. About 250 ms, bright, dry, no bass.
Gentle curious rising purr: two soft ascending chiptune notes like a shy fish drifting closer to investigate. About 400 ms, warm, quiet, smooth fade, no bass.
Playful cluster of small air bubbles rising and popping at the surface, stylized as bubbly chiptune blips at varying pitches. About 500 ms, bright, light, no bass, no reverb.
Very quiet plaintive 8-bit chirp: two soft notes with a slight wobble, like a hungry little fish asking at the glass. About 300 ms, gentle, no bass, fades to silence.

Warm hopeful retro game startup jingle for a tiny pixel-art fish tank waking up for the first time: four or five ascending chiptune notes that bloom into a shimmering bubbly finish. About 2 seconds, bright, cheerful, no bass, clean fade out.
Joyful little fanfare for a newborn fish arriving: a short bright chiptune flourish with a rising bubbly sparkle on top. About 1.5 seconds, celebratory but small, no bass, clean fade.
Short achievement chime: three quick ascending bright chiptune notes ending in a small sparkle. About 500 ms, clean, no bass, no reverb.
Level-up growth chime: a rising four-note chiptune arpeggio landing on one held bright note. About 700 ms, triumphant but tiny, no bass, clean fade.

sleep: a soft descending three-note chiptune yawn that slows down, like a small device drifting off; about 600 ms, gentle, fades to silence. wake: the same three notes ascending, a bright fresh good-morning boop; about 500 ms, clean.
Subtle two-note descending warning boop, slightly hollow, like a small device politely asking to be charged. About 400 ms, not alarming, no bass.
Short flat error bonk: a single dull low-mid retro buzz followed by a quick double blip. About 300 ms, dry, nothing below 600 Hz.
